scope: Sidebar scoped read recovery, synthetic project fixture cleanup, and earlier local archive/list/merge/project regressions

node_regression.evidence: Actual compiled components/hooks/callbacks/JSX, installed React static markup and subscribed QueryObserver/MutationObserver transitions. Actual sidebar query callbacks invoke explicit synthetic transport. Expansion, selection, lifecycle/focus scheduling, storage, DnD, unrelated children and server state are doubles. Three cases run actual extracted browser fixture helpers, not an API or browser.

baseline.note: Six passing controls preserve existing healthy links/drop ids/query scope, cached project/branch retention and collapsed-branch disabling. Earlier harness setup failure and 35-case 2-pass/33-fail run are recorded in baseline.json.

fixture_cleanup.correction: Re-archive only the exact synthetic project before cleanup DELETE after a restore or fixture-creation failure.
fixture_cleanup.counter_evidence: Existing project_service.py:204-207 and projects.py:103-111 reject deleting active projects with HTTP 422. Earlier ERR-02 proves stale request admission in a callback double, not successful active-project deletion. No server guard changed.
fixture_cleanup.browser_clock_review: Archive/sidebar reconnect probes advance 20 seconds, exceeding the unchanged QueryProvider 15-second staleTime. An earlier 11-second advance alone did not establish staleness. No browser failure is claimed.

previous_api_verification.basis: Seven previously checked API implementation/test hashes are unchanged; the unchanged projects route is also included in the source inventory.

browser_discovery.command: corepack pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/ux-recovery-followup.spec.ts --list --output <task-temp>/sidebar-read-discovery
intended_assertions: 375px Chinese/light and 1440px English/dark: project list, Unclassified and expanded-project regions retain actual reading-link identity and focus through injected read errors.
Held Retry keeps the same node and scopes busy status to its query. Only its GET count increases; no project/conversation write or navigation occurs.
Two initial expanded-project failures show explicit Retry, not empty drop guidance, and recover without collapsing the branch.
Synthetic message JSON and project/Unclassified memberships remain unchanged. Existing real project/history endpoints are used without fabricating list contents.
Only synthetic fixtures are created/cleaned. Reconnect staleness is advanced past the existing default. No screenshots were generated and no browser was launched in this batch.

implementation.retained_read: Current-query cached rows and links remain through transient errors, with localized status and a scoped read-only Retry. No second data cache.
implementation.initial_error: Initial/empty-cache failures remain errors. Project drop guidance requires a successful empty read. Unknown Unclassified count is not represented as zero.
implementation.access: HTTP 401/403/404 hides affected cached rows; archived/default projects are excluded from the active sidebar. Unrelated caches are not cleared.
implementation.unchanged: DnD sensors, placement/revision mutation functions, query keys, route hrefs, project creation/archive actions, API/schema, dependencies and approved design tokens.
implementation.limitation: No guarantee of previous data after a new sort key fails without a current cache; static evidence does not prove actual focus/drag continuity.
